description:
[Interviews] List the merchant's interviews and positions, with lifecycle, category, tags, recruiter and step count; filter by lifecycle, recruiter_profile_id or interview_category. type=interview (the default) also lists multi-stage positions.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

filter_emoji.description: Filter by the interview emoji marker.

filter_text.description: Case-insensitive search on the interview name.

interview_category.description: Only definitions in this job category (case and surrounding spaces ignored).

lifecycle.description: Only multi-stage positions in this vacancy lifecycle (as lifecycle_status shows it). Interviews have no lifecycle, so this lists positions only.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

recruiter_profile_id.description: Only definitions owned by this recruiter (`profile_id` (list_users)).

show_public.description: Include interviews shared publicly across merchants (coaching/avatars).

status.description: Filter by publication status (preparing: a draft still being prepared; completed: finished, read as closed). Omit to include all statuses.

type.description: Which kind to list. Values: `interview` (default): interviews, assessments, interview role-plays | `coaching`: coaching sessions and coaching personas | `assessment`: assessments only | `persona`: coaching personas only | `persona_interview`: interview role-plays only | `public_avatar`: public avatars.

name: list_interviews
title: List interviews and positions
